title: Dr. Cesar Tapia Awarded American College of Dentists Fellowship
html:
Dr. Cesar Tapia, founder of ConfiDENT in Alpharetta and Cumming, Georgia, was awarded Fellowship in the American College of Dentists on October 24, 2026, during the College’s Annual Meeting and Convocation in Santa Barbara, California. Fellowship in the College is by invitation and is based on demonstrated leadership and contributions to the dental profession and society.

Dr. Cesar Tapia of Alpharetta, Georgia, was awarded Fellowship in the American College of Dentists (ACD) on October 24, 2026, during its Annual Meeting and Convocation in Santa Barbara, California. Dr. Tapia is the founder of ConfiDENT, a general, cosmetic, and implant dental practice with offices in Alpharetta and Cumming that serves families throughout the North Atlanta area.

The American College of Dentists was founded in 1920 to recognize dentists who have made significant contributions to the advancement of excellence, ethics, professionalism, and leadership in oral healthcare. Fellowship in the College is by invitation and is based on demonstrated leadership and contributions to the dental profession and society. Fewer than 4% of dentists in the United States are invited to become Fellows. The College’s annual Convocation formally welcomes each new class of Fellows into the organization.

Originally from Lima, Peru, Dr. Tapia earned his Doctorate in Dental Surgery and completed his residency at the University of Colorado before establishing ConfiDENT in Alpharetta. He has since earned two master’s credentials in implantology from the International Congress of Oral Implantologists and the American Academy of Implant Prosthodontics. In 2025, he was named an Associate Fellow of the American Academy of Implant Dentistry. In addition to leading his practice, he continues to pursue advanced education in implant and restorative dentistry so that patients in Alpharetta, Cumming, and the surrounding communities have access to comprehensive care close to home.

At ConfiDENT, Dr. Tapia and his team provide preventive and family dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, All-on-X full-mouth restorations, LANAP® and LAPIP® laser periodontal treatment, clear aligners, and same-day crowns. The fully digital practice uses in-office milling for same-day crowns and 3-D printing for nightguards and retainers.

“Being welcomed as a Fellow of the American College of Dentists in Santa Barbara was one of the proudest moments of my career,” said Dr. Tapia. “The College has stood for ethics, professionalism, and leadership in dentistry for more than a century, and those are the same values I try to bring to my patients and my team every day. I am honored to join this group of colleagues, and I look forward to supporting the College’s work for our profession and the communities we serve.”

More About ConfiDENT and Dr. Cesar Tapia

ConfiDENT is a dental practice serving the North Atlanta community from two locations in Alpharetta and Cumming, Georgia. Founded by Cesar Tapia, DDS, AFAAID, FACD, MICOI, MAAIP, the practice offers routine and preventive care, cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, All-on-X full-mouth restorations, LANAP® and LAPIP® laser therapy, clear aligners, same-day crowns, extractions, wisdom teeth removal, and emergency dental care. Dr. Tapia earned his Doctorate in Dental Surgery and completed his residency at the University of Colorado. He holds master’s credentials from the International Congress of Oral Implantologists and the American Academy of Implant Prosthodontics, is an Associate Fellow of the American Academy of Implant Dentistry, and is a Fellow of the American College of Dentists.

ConfiDENT’s Alpharetta office is located at 11550 Webb Bridge Way, Suite 1, Alpharetta, GA 30005, and its Cumming office is located at 422 Canton Road, Cumming, GA 30040.
